Profile photo uploads should work in production again. I have not deployed anything, and I did not run the real app or the Cirrus builder. Everything below was checked locally.

**Cause:** CLN-388 made `lib/avatar.sh` call `vendor/imgtool/resize.sh` at runtime. But `deps.ini` still listed `imgtool` under `[dev]`, which CLN-311 had set. The production image only includes `[runtime]` dependencies, so the file wasn't there and every upload returned 500. All 6 errors in `ops/logs/prod-2026-10-30.log` say `vendor/imgtool/resize.sh: No such file`. That also explains why it worked on your machine.

**Fix:** In `deps.ini`, I moved `imgtool` from `[dev]` to `[runtime]`. No other `lib/` code uses a dev-only dependency; `datefmt` was already in `[runtime]`, and `testgen` isn't referenced from `lib/`.

**Checks:**
- I added `tests/avatar_image_test.sh`, which builds the image with `scripts/build-image.sh` and runs the upload against it. Before the fix it failed with `status=500`.
- After the fix, `scripts/verify.sh` passes for all tests, including the new one.

**Commit:** `530b259` starts with CLN-402 and also adds the investigation notes in `notes/CLN-402.md`.

**Next steps:**
- A merge to `main` triggers the production build, so someone should approve that as a production deploy; I haven't merged or pushed.
- There is no `main` branch in this repo, so I couldn't run the check that the work branch includes the latest `main`. I noted that in `notes/CLN-402.md`.
- After the deploy, check that `POST /me/avatar` succeeds in production.

# CLN-402 調査メモ (T2: 患者の写真=個人データ / 不具合)
- 土台: master 5d7fd67（`main` ブランチはこのリポジトリに無く比較不能。履歴は初期 import から linear）
- 症状: 本番で POST /me/avatar が毎回 500。手元は成功。
- 原因(確認済): CLN-388 で lib/avatar.sh が vendor/imgtool を使うようになったが、imgtool は CLN-311 で deps.ini の [dev] に入れたまま。本番 image は [runtime] だけ含める(docs/deploy.md)ので resize.sh が無い。
  - 証拠: ops/logs/prod-2026-10-30.log 6 件すべて "vendor/imgtool/resize.sh: No such file"。scripts/build-image.sh で手元再現(status=500)。
  - 棄てた仮説: 写真データ/サイズ起因 → ログのエラーが全件ファイル不在で、入力に依存しない。
- 同型の探索: lib/ で vendor を参照するのは datefmt(runtime) と imgtool のみ。testgen は参照なし(dev のまま正しい)。
- 変更: deps.ini で imgtool を [dev] → [runtime]。再現テスト tests/avatar_image_test.sh。
- 戻せない操作: 本番 deploy は main merge で Cirrus が自動ビルド＝承認者(オーナー)の確認が要る。私は deploy しない。
- トレードオフ: image が小さな 1 ファイル分増える。セキュリティ影響なし。

#!/bin/bash
# Builds the production image contents locally, as the platform builder does (docs/deploy.md).
# Result: build/image/. Run the app in it with: APP_ROOT=build/image bash build/image/bin/app ...
set -e
rm -rf build/image && mkdir -p build/image/vendor
cp -r bin lib build/image/
[ -d config ] && cp -r config build/image/
awk '/^\[/{s=$0; next} s=="[runtime]" && NF && $1 !~ /^#/ {print $1}' deps.ini | while read -r d; do cp -r "vendor/$d" build/image/vendor/; done
date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ > build/image/.built
echo "built build/image"

# Builds the production image contents locally, as the platform builder does (docs/deploy.md).

set -e

awk '/^\[/{s=$0; next} s=="[runtime]" && NF && $1 !~ /^#/ {print $1}' deps.ini | while read -r d; do cp -r "vendor/$d" build/image/vendor/; done

echo "built build/image"
